name: Infomaniak SA
summary: Infomaniak SA engages in the design, development, operation, and provision of cloud technology and digital infrastructure in Switzerland, Europe, and internationally. The company provides a collaborative suite, such as kSuite, a suite of online productivity and collaboration tools that offers mail service, storage service, video-conferencing solutions, and a communication platform; web and domain solutions, including domain names, web hosting, cloud servers, SSL certificates, site creator, and WordPress hosting; and cloud services, such as GPU cloud, VPS cloud, VPS Lite, database service, Kubernetes services, public cloud, and Jelastic cloud services.
